Name: Challenging Community Center Bundles
Author: Jaksha
TagLine: A bundle overhaul mod which tries to create a challenging but not frustrating experience playing Stardew Valley.
Description:
[![](https://i.imgur.com/hpHHXsx.png)](https://i.imgur.com/hpHHXsx.png)

[![](https://i.imgur.com/br9RloX.png)](https://i.imgur.com/br9RloX.png)

This overhaul attempts to create a challenging but not frustrating experience fulfilling the community center bundles while also providing more variety to these.

**We offer different bundles versions:**
- A vanilla styled bundles version
- A PPJA (Project Populate Json Assets) inspired  bundles version which utilizes the new machines, crops, trees, etc. provided by PPJA

All versions come with SVE (Stardew Valley Expanded) support, which will be auto detected by the Mod. This means that the new fish, items and cooking recipes from SVE will be a part of the bundles.

Included are some customized foraging items (possible with Farm Type Manager) and special rewards for fulfilling the bundles as well.
'Challenging' is interpreted as needing crops/fruits/artisan products only available after year 2 or later, utilizing more artisan machines, the necessity for buying and saving products for cooking recipes or trying your luck in the mines.

Maybe you should save some of these precious artifacts you discover around town, too~

[![](https://i.imgur.com/4HgJ9np.png)](https://i.imgur.com/4HgJ9np.png)

### Vanilla Bundles Version

- Download and install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/ "SMAPI")
- Download and install the latest version of [Content Patcher](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher "Content Patcher")
- Download and install the latest version of [Farm Type Manager](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/598755-farm-type-manager-ftm "Farm Type Manager")
- Download the latest version of this mod and unzip it, then copy the '[CP] Challenging Community Center Bundles' and '[FTM] Challenging Community Center Bundles - Forage Pack' folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
- You're done; run the game using SMAPI!

[![](https://i.imgur.com/fJjtjTh.png)](https://i.imgur.com/fJjtjTh.png)

### PPJA Bundles Version

- Download and install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/ "SMAPI")
- Download and install the latest version of [Content Patcher](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher "Content Patcher")
- Download and install the latest version of [Farm Type Manager](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/598755-farm-type-manager-ftm "Farm Type Manager")
- Download and install the latest version of [Json Assets](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/399895-json-assets "Json Assets")
- Download and install the latest version of at least the following PPJA mods (it's up to you, if you want to use more than these, but those are required):
 - [PPJA - Artisan Valley](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/660997-ppja-artisan-valley "Artisan Valley")
 - [PPJA -Fruits and Veggies](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/660885-ppja-fruits-and-veggies "Fruits and Veggies")
 - [PPJA - Mizu's Flowers](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/661008-ppja-mizus-flowers "PPJA - Mizu's Flowers")
 - [PPJA - More Trees](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/660964-ppja-more-trees "PPJA - More Trees")
 - [PPJA - More Recipes](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/660943-ppja-more-recipes_a-collection-of-recipes "PPJA - More Recipes")
 - [PPJA - Event More Recipes (Without Meat)](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/660984-ppja-even-more-recipes_another-collection-of-recipes "PPJA - Event More Recipes (Without Meat)")
- Download the latest version of this mod and unzip it, then copy the '[CP] Challenging Community Center Bundles' and '[FTM] Challenging Community Center Bundles - Forage Pack' folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
- Open the config.json in the [CP] Challenging Community Center Bundles folder and set the "Variant" variable to "PPJA", default would be "Vanilla"
- You're done; run the game using SMAPI!

**Please note: This mod is not officially endorsed by PPJA, so please delegate your bug reports for CCCB to us ;)**
